statement: Solventum Corporation had $897 million in cash and cash equivalents at June 30, 2024, with approximately $378 million held by foreign subsidiaries and $519 million in the United States.

The increase in cash and cash equivalents from December 31, 2023 ($194 million) to June 30, 2024 ($897 million) resulted from cash retained by the Company at Spin-Off and operating cash generated post-Spin-Off.
Lockheed Martin Corporation's Missiles and Fire Control (MFC) business segment sales increased $380 million, or 13%, in FY2025 Q1 compared to FY2024 Q1.
The MFC sales increase was primarily driven by a $370 million increase in sales from tactical and strike missile programs, including JASSM, LRASM, and precision fires programs.
MFC's operating profit increased $154 million, or 50%, in FY2025 Q1 compared to FY2024 Q1.
LyondellBasell N.V.'s O&P-EAI segment benefited from polyethylene margin expansion due to increased utilization of advantaged liquified petroleum gas (LPG) feedstocks in Europe.
Assurant, Inc.'s Global Housing Adjusted EBITDA increased $6.3 million, or 4%, to $160.9 million for Second Quarter 2024 compared with Second Quarter 2023.

The increase in Global Housing Adjusted EBITDA was primarily from continued top-line growth within Homeowners, including higher policies in-force from new lender-placed programs and portfolios, and ongoing expense leverage from scale and operational efficiencies.
Lam Research Corporation's memory market segment revenue decreased from 48% of systems revenue in December 2023 to 44% in March 2024.
The memory segment's DRAM spending accounted for 23% of systems revenue in March 2024, down from 31% in December 2023.
Lockheed Martin Corporation repaid $168 million of long-term notes with a fixed interest rate of 8.375% during the nine months ended September 29, 2024, according to their scheduled maturities.
NIKE, Inc.'s Greater China revenues increased 6% on a currency-neutral basis in FY2024 Q3 compared to FY2023 Q3 due to higher revenues in Men's, Women's, Kids', and the Jordan Brand.
NIKE, Inc.'s Wholesale revenues increased 12% in FY2024 Q3 compared to FY2023 Q3.
Globe Life Inc.'s American Income Division's average producing agent count increased 3% in the first quarter of 2025 compared to the year-ago period.
The increase in average producing agent count for the American Income Division was driven by new agent recruiting and improved new agent retention.
The average producing agent count for the American Income Division was 11,510 at March 31, 2025, up from 11,139 in the year-ago period.
Globe Life Inc. invested in technology, including a CRM tool and virtual recruiting systems, to support agency growth and retention.
News Corporation's Digital Real Estate Services segment EBITDA increased $18 million, or 15%, for the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same period in fiscal 2024.

The increase in Digital Real Estate Services segment EBITDA was primarily driven by higher profit contribution from REA Group, including revenue growth and a $3 million positive impact from foreign currency fluctuations.
PPG Industries, Inc. signed an agreement to sell its global silicas products business to QEMETICA S.A. for approximately $310 million in pre-tax proceeds during the third quarter 2024.

PPG Industries, Inc. announced a strategic review of its architectural coatings U.S. and Canada business during the first quarter 2024, which culminated in a definitive agreement to sell the business to American Industrial Partners (AIP) for approximately $550 million.

IQVIA Holdings Inc.'s Contract Sales & Medical Solutions (CSMS) revenue decreased 1.6% in the third quarter of 2024 compared to the same period in 2023, with a constant currency decrease of approximately $2 million, or 1.1%.

CSMS revenue for the first nine months of 2024 was consistent with the same period in 2023 at $541 million, with constant currency revenue growth of approximately $16 million, or 3.0%, primarily due to volume-related increases in services performed in the Europe and Africa region and to a lesser extent the Asia-Pacific region.
WEC Energy Group, Inc.'s non-utility energy infrastructure segment's interest expense decreased $1.4 million in FY2024 Q3 compared to the same quarter in 2023.
WEC Energy Group, Inc.'s non-utility energy infrastructure segment's income tax benefit increased $9.3 million in FY2024 Q3 compared to the same quarter in 2023.
M&T Bank Corporation's taxable-equivalent net interest income increased $40 million in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the first quarter of 2024.
The increase in net interest income was primarily due to a 7 basis-point expansion of the net interest margin.
The net interest margin expansion resulted from deploying cash to new loan originations and investment securities purchases with higher yields.

Abbott Laboratories' Diabetes Care segment sales increased 21.6 percent in the first three months of 2025, excluding foreign exchange, with CGM systems sales totaling $1.7 billion compared to $1.5 billion in the same period of 2024.

Abbott Laboratories' Rhythm Management segment sales increased 6.1 percent in the first three months of 2025, excluding foreign exchange, primarily due to growth in Aveir® leadless pacemakers, partially offset by a decrease in traditional pacemaker and implantable cardioverter-defibrillator sales.
J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc.'s DCS segment operating income decreased 15% to $96.4 million in the second quarter 2024 compared to $113.6 million in 2023.

The DCS segment operating income decrease was primarily due to decreased revenue, increased insurance premium expense, increased equipment-related costs, higher bad debt expense, and higher new account start-up costs, partially offset by lower maintenance costs and the maturing of new business onboarded over the past year.
Phillips 66 completed the conversion of its San Francisco Refinery into the Rodeo Renewable Energy Complex (RREC) by the end of the second quarter of 2024.
The Rodeo Renewable Energy Complex (RREC) processes approximately 50,000 barrels per day of renewable feedstocks into renewable fuels, including renewable diesel and renewable jet fuel.
The RREC is expected to start producing sustainable aviation fuel in the third quarter of 2024, with the flexibility to produce up to 10,000 barrels per day.
The completion of the RREC expansion positions Phillips 66 as a leader in renewable fuels production.
American Water Works Company, Inc.'s pension and postretirement benefit plan liabilities are sensitive to changes in interest rates.
A decline in the market value of American Water Works Company, Inc.'s pension and postretirement benefit plan assets can increase funding requirements.
Changes in discount rate assumptions can materially affect funding requirements for American Water Works Company, Inc.'s pension and postretirement plans.
Wells Fargo & Company repurchased shares under a $30 billion authorization approved by the Board of Directors and announced on July 25, 2023.

Gilead Sciences' Trodelvy is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer who have received two or more prior systemic therapies, at least one of them for metastatic disease, and unresectable locally advanced or metastatic hormone receptor-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative breast cancer who have received endocrine-based therapy and at least two additional systemic therapies in the metastatic setting.
Trodelvy maintains market leadership in the metastatic triple negative breast cancer setting across both the U.S. and Europe, and is approved in 55 markets.
Zebra Technologies Corporation's Consolidated Organic Net sales increased by 30.6% in FY2024 Q3 compared to FY2023 Q3.
The increase in Consolidated Organic Net sales was primarily due to growth in both of the company's segments.
Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated has activated more than 50 authorized treatment centers across the U.S., Europe, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and the UAE for CASGEVY.
Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated is working to expand access to CASGEVY in Europe and the Middle East through engagement with payors and national health authorities.
PTC Inc.'s PLM software revenue growth for the first nine months of FY'24 (excluding Q1'24 ServiceMax revenue) would have been 6% year-over-year in constant currency.
PTC Inc.'s PLM ARR grew 12% (13% constant currency) from Q3’23 to Q3'24.
PTC Inc.'s CAD software revenue decreased in Q3'24 compared to Q3'23, primarily due to lower revenue in the Americas.
PTC Inc.'s CAD ARR grew 8% (10% constant currency) from Q3’23 to Q3'24.
Applied Materials, Inc.'s Semiconductor Systems net revenue increased 1% in FY2024 compared to FY2023.
The increase in Semiconductor Systems net revenue was driven by customer investments in new capacity and new technology transitions.
Foundry and logic customers' spending in Semiconductor Systems decreased in FY2024 due to lower investments in leading-edge manufacturing technologies.
Memory customers' spending in Semiconductor Systems increased in FY2024 due to higher investments in DRAM technology transitions.
3M Company's credit ratings are A3 from Moody's Investors Service, BBB+ from S&P Global Ratings, and A- from Fitch, all with stable outlooks as of the filing date.
3M's credit ratings impact its cost of capital and borrowing costs, with strong ratings historically lowering borrowing costs and facilitating access to lenders.

Deere & Company's Construction and Forestry (CF) segment delivers smart and sustainable solutions, including SmartWeigh™, grade control, automation, and Operations Center, to address industry challenges like labor shortages and input costs.
The CF segment plans to introduce hybrid-electric and battery electric equipment solutions to reduce tailpipe emissions while maintaining power and performance.
Eaton Corporation plc's operating margin increased from 26.4% in the second quarter of 2023 to 29.9% in the second quarter of 2024.

The operating margin increase was driven by a 530 basis point contribution from higher sales and a 190 basis point contribution from operating efficiencies, partially offset by a 170 basis point decline from higher costs to support growth initiatives and a 130 basis point decline from higher commodity and wage inflation.
The Procter & Gamble Company separated its Skin and Personal Care segments into individual operating segments, Skin Care and Personal Care, effective July 1, 2024.
The separation of Skin and Personal Care included distinct management teams, strategic decision-making, innovation plans, financial targets, budgets, and management reporting.
Occidental Petroleum Corp repaid $402 million of current maturities in July 2024.
As of June 30, 2024, Occidental had $1.2 billion of debt maturities due in the next 12 months.
Solventum Corporation had $772 million in cash and cash equivalents as of September 30, 2024, with approximately $570 million held by foreign subsidiaries and $202 million in the United States.
The increase in cash and cash equivalents from December 31, 2023, to September 30, 2024, resulted from cash retained by the Company at Spin-Off and operating cash generated post-Spin-Off.
Texas Instruments Incorporated's Analog segment revenue increased 13% in Q1 2025 compared with Q1 2024.
Texas Instruments Incorporated's Analog segment operating profit increased 20% in Q1 2025 compared with Q1 2024.
Agilent CrossLab segment revenue increased 1 percent in FY2025 Q1 compared to FY2024 Q1.
Foreign currency movements had an overall unfavorable impact of 2 percentage points on Agilent CrossLab segment revenue growth in FY2025 Q1.
Visa Inc.'s general and administrative expenses increased over the nine months ended June 30, 2024 compared to the prior-year comparable period.
Moody's Corporation's global MA revenue increased 8% in FY2024 Q3 compared to the same period in the prior year.
Moody's Corporation's ARR (2) grew 9% in FY2024 Q3, reflecting increases across all LOBs.
The 8% growth in Moody's Corporation's global MA revenue was driven by increases in both the U.S. (5%) and international markets (9%).
Moody's Corporation's Insurance revenue and ARR (2) grew 9% and 13%, respectively, in FY2024 Q3.
Moody's Corporation's Banking revenue and ARR (2) grew 4% and 10%, respectively, in FY2024 Q3.
Valero Energy Corp's refining segment operating income decreased $1.208 billion in Q2 2024 compared to Q2 2023.
Valero Energy Corp's refining segment adjusted operating income decreased $1.204 billion in Q2 2024 compared to Q2 2023.

NRG Energy, Inc. acquired six power generation facilities from Rockland Capital, LLC, adding 738 MW of natural gas-fired assets in Texas for $560 million in consideration, subject to working capital adjustments.
Chubb Limited repurchased $2.0 billion of Common Shares in 2024 under the Board's share repurchase authorization.
Chubb Limited repurchased $148 million in Common Shares between January 1, 2025, and February 26, 2025.
Chubb Limited had $1.5 billion remaining in share repurchase authorization as of February 26, 2025.
Apple Inc.'s iPad net sales decreased 17% in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the second quarter of 2023.
Apple Inc.'s iPad net sales decreased 22% in the first six months of 2024 compared to the first six months of 2023.

Global Payments Inc. faces potential regulatory risks from noncompliance with data privacy regulations such as the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act (GLBA), and the California Privacy Rights Act, which could result in substantial fines, penalties, or damages from private causes of action.

Global Payments Inc. may face expanded compliance obligations under evolving privacy regulations, including the EU Artificial Intelligence Regulation, new state laws in the United States, or a potential federal privacy law, which could limit data usage and increase compliance costs.
Global Payments Inc. relies on third-party partners to comply with applicable regulations, and failures by these partners could impact the Company's operations.

Yum! Brands, Inc. experienced a low single-digit headwind to overall same-store sales growth in the quarter and year to date ended June 30, 2024 due to the Middle East conflict impacting markets in the Middle East, Malaysia, and Indonesia.

The Middle East conflict is ongoing, and its dynamic nature makes it difficult to forecast any impacts on Yum! Brands, Inc.'s balance of year 2024 revenues, operating profit, and unit count with any certainty.
